interpretation_notes: Every page of both fully read Modbus artifacts was visually checked, not only pages with detected Figure captions. Tables, state flowcharts, protocol examples and unlabeled diagrams are included.
SCPI visual coverage is chapter 9 status reporting pages 50–57 and error-queue figure page 517 only. Other text excerpts have no separate visual completeness claim.
Serial visual coverage is pages 7–11 only, including controller/server state and transaction/broadcast timing diagrams.
Automated figure-caption extraction is an index aid, not a complete inventory of graphical content.
